children: GMR Solutions announced a term loan repricing that cuts its interest margin by 50 bps and includes a $200 million voluntary paydown.
Global Medical Response obtained binding lender commitments to reprice its first lien term loan facility.
GMR will voluntarily prepay approximately $200 million, reducing outstanding principal to about $2.7 billion.
Interest margin on the term loan will decrease from SOFR +3.25% to SOFR +2.75% (50 bps reduction).
Company expects roughly $28 million of annual cash interest expense savings from the repricing and paydown.
Transaction expected to close on or about Sept. 17, 2026, subject to definitive documentation and customary conditions.
